journey.name: Enable notifications snackbar
journey.description:
Covers the POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompt on the Node tab: the app must never open the system permission dialog on its own at launch, the snackbar must offer "Enable", and — the regression this journey exists for — the snackbar must disappear on its own the moment the permission is granted through the system dialog, without the user dismissing it.
PRECONDITION: the permission must not be granted. Reset it before starting with `adb shell pm revoke com.github.jvsena42.mandacaru android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS` followed by `adb shell am force-stop com.github.jvsena42.mandacaru`. Revoking is only meaningful on Android 13+ (API 33); on older devices notifications are granted at install time, so mark every snackbar step SKIPPED rather than FAILED.

actions.action: Revoke the notification permission and force-stop the app (`adb shell pm revoke com.github.jvsena42.mandacaru android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS` then `adb shell am force-stop com.github.jvsena42.mandacaru`); if the device is below API 33, SKIP the remaining steps
Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Verify no system permission dialog is on screen — the layout shows the app's own UI, not a "Allow Mandacaru to send you notifications?" dialog
Verify the enable-notifications snackbar (snackbar_enable_notifications) is present on the Node tab
Verify the snackbar offers an "Enable" action (target by text) and not "Open settings"
Tap the "Enable" action on the snackbar (by text)
Verify the system permission dialog now appears (it renders in a separate window, so target its buttons by text)
Tap "Allow" on the system permission dialog
Verify snackbar_enable_notifications is no longer present, without having tapped its ✕ — poll the layout for up to 5 seconds to allow the exit animation to finish
Verify no second permission dialog appears and the app has not crashed (nav_node is still present and selected)
Verify the foreground service notification is now posted (`adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -i mandacaru` shows an entry)
